name: two-views
note: B18c's run on wj-ia-300's session fixture, in sample mode at the owner's 2000x1200: before a cap is named Local is not drawn and frames are one-view frames; naming cap 150 draws Local beside Global as the second pane of composite frames (orthographic, only the cap's turning region, pulled apart); two twists (J, the router's KeyJ, which sample mode's twist row must not take) and an undo keep both views on one revision.
